items.title: Liquidity to peak in Sept, but big surplus won't last long: RBI

Economists anticipate a surplus of around ₹4-5 lakh crore in the banking system. The central bank will then begin withdrawing excess liquidity through durable absorption measures.

items.title: Govt mandates exporter registration for FDI-backed ecommerce inventory exports

This framework aims to boost India's export capabilities and ensure timely payments.

items.title: Regulators weigh bringing insurance surety bonds under RBI's CRILC
